name: form680-autonotes
description: Automated generation of Form §680 Daily Progress Notes from monthly shift log PDFs

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test:reports: tsx --test server/src/services/zipper.test.ts server/src/services/exportPlan.test.ts server/src/services/quarterlyTemplate.test.ts server/src/services/printImports.test.ts server/src/services/jobPolicy.test.ts server/src/services/local/evidence.test.ts server/src/services/logWriter/writer.test.ts server/src/services/voice/parse.test.ts server/src/services/voice/apply.test.ts
